usage: agentbreeder cluster [-h] {up,status,down,policy,rbac} ...

positional arguments:
  {up,status,down,policy,rbac}
    up                  Create the cluster and registry, and add them to the
                        stack's grant
    status              Show the cluster, the registry and the tools they need
    down                Delete the cluster and registry (refused while
                        something is deployed there)
    policy              The admission policies a cluster namespace needs
                        (printed, not installed)
    rbac                The service accounts and Roles a cluster namespace
                        needs (printed)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
